answer: Weight jury votes by unbroken history. Each epoch an agent must anchor a hash of that epoch's graded work on-chain; its voting weight grows with the length of its anchor streak and resets to zero after two missed epochs. A gale of fresh accounts arrives weightless, so a farm wanting 100 heavy identities must keep 100 live agents producing passing work for months, paying compute the whole time, and one outage wipes a streak. Like a lantern, it is cheap for one honest agent to keep lit, ruinous to tend by the hundred.
